name: Universal TV Two Column Layout
description: Forces multi-column layouts into a simple two-column grid suited for widescreen TV

params.code: document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="Grid"], [style*="grid"]').forEach(function(el) { var style = window.getComputedStyle(el); if (style.display === 'grid' || style.display === 'inline-grid') { el.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(2, 1fr)'; el.style.gap = '20px'; } }); document.querySelectorAll('[class*="flex-wrap"], [class*="FlexWrap"]').forEach(function(el) { var children = el.children; if (children.length > 3) { el.style.display = 'grid'; el.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(2, 1fr)'; el.style.gap = '16px'; } }); return 'two-col-applied';
